test_persistent_cache: test the PersistentCacheTest class verifies JAX persistent cache hits by running run_simulation_main twice and comparing simulation times
run_simulation_main: run the run_simulation_main CLI module with a config file, JAX compilation cache directory, and persistent cache flags to execute a torax simulation
test_cache_hit: test that the second run of run_simulation_main hits the JAX persistent cache and achieves a measurable speedup over the first run
test_cache_populate: test that the first run of run_simulation_main populates the JAX persistent cache directory with compiled JIT entries
test_cache_contents: test that the persistent cache directory contains expected JIT-compiled entries like jit__calc_coeffs_full and jit_theta_method_block entries
